ValidationItems: Guest NVMe readiness: Validation Required - Standard_D4s_v6 supports NVMe only; confirm the guest OS has NVMe drivers and discovers OS/data disks over NVMe before conversion (Azure controller support does not prove guest readiness).

Gen1 to Gen2: Validation Required - Microsoft supports Gen1 to Gen2 only through the Trusted launch upgrade (supported OS and size; not Windows Server 2016, Debian or Azure Linux). Validate MBR to GPT conversion, boot and rollback.

MANA networking: Validation Required - Standard_D4s_v6 uses the Microsoft Azure Network Adapter; confirm guest MANA driver support (Accelerated Networking on the current VM does not prove MANA readiness).

Temporary disk: Unknown / workload validation required - current size has a 28 GB temp disk and Standard_D4s_v6 has none; confirm the workload does not depend on it (pagefile, tempdb, caches, scripts).
